scope: All140 remaining additions notes were triaged:105 vowel/shuruq positions freshly inspected here and35 dagesh positions carried forward from the immediately preceding complete exact-letter sweep. method: Original embedded bilevel A2 raster pixels only. Source words and exact target positions were located in page context; narrow point areas were inspected at native resolution and15x nearest-neighbor. Wider unchanged word/row crops establish the target location. Initial blank, clipped or offset scratch frames were repaired before final evidence was saved. Broad vav feet, connected ink, pinholes and partial source strokes do not certify a point by analogy or grammar. No grayscale transformation, sharpening, AI reconstruction, OCR or another translator supplied readings. The35 already unambiguous dagesh failures were not re-presented as new visual work.

sourceLocatorCorrections.explanation: The repeated אעֱשׂנָּה words for SUS22 and SUS23 occur on the same first lower-Theodotion source row. The prior rightmost crop shows SUS22 after וְאִם־לֹא. SUS23 follows the printed כג marker and begins וְעַתָּה טוֹב לִי כִּי לֹא, placing its repeated word much farther left. This pass inspects that actual left occurrence and retains both unresolved points. Prior reports remain immutable historical records; their SUS23 source-locator claim is explicitly superseded here. Prior distinct-ID review counts do not establish correct location for these two positions.
